[[Image:River Shal map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''River Shal''' rises in the [[Hills of Kintara]] and flows south and west into [[Illian]], where it meets the [[Manetherendrelle]]. It is located northwest of the [[Doirlon Hills]] and, along with them, forms the western edge of the [[Plains of Maredo]].
